title: Musk v. Altman: Much ado about nothing
brief: Elon Musk lost his lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI over the company's conversion to a for-profit entity; the jury found the case was filed after the statute of limitations expired. The trial, which became a public spectacle with daily protests and courtroom disruptions, revealed that Musk's real motivation was punishing Altman rather than pursuing substantive legal claims about charitable trust violations.
